If you visit a tournament where Bharat Singh Chauhan is an organizer or part of the core team, more often than not, you will see him playing blitz against young talents, fellow organizers, or just about anyone he finds. This year, he completed 50 years in chess, from playing tournaments in 1976 to 2026, conducting events like Olympiads and world championships; he has seen it all.
We caught up with him at the Asian Nations Chess Cup 2026. Check out this interview.
Interview: Devansh Singh
